text:
Look away from the screen.
Let your eyes rest on something far away.

Stand up, roll your shoulders
and take three slow breaths.
Very little is needed to make a happy life.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: No man ever steps in the same river twice.
author: Heraclitus

text:
Nature does not hurry,
yet everything is accomplished.
author: Lao Tzu

text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: Unclench your jaw. Drop your shoulders.
Do every act of your life as though it were the last.
author: Marcus Aurelius
